from PIL import Image

base = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0513/projects/occsafe_vla/artifacts/figures'

a = Image.open(f'{base}/fig1_panel_a.png').convert('RGBA')
b = Image.open(f'{base}/fig1_panel_b.png').convert('RGBA')

# Scale both to same width (use the larger width for quality)
target_w = max(a.size[0], b.size[0])
gap = 30  # pixels gap between panels

# Resize panel A to target width
a_ratio = target_w / a.size[0]
a_resized = a.resize((target_w, int(a.size[1] * a_ratio)), Image.LANCZOS)

# Resize panel B to target width
b_ratio = target_w / b.size[0]
b_resized = b.resize((target_w, int(b.size[1] * b_ratio)), Image.LANCZOS)

# Create combined canvas (white background)
total_h = a_resized.size[1] + gap + b_resized.size[1]
combined = Image.new('RGB', (target_w, total_h), (255, 255, 255))

# Paste panels
combined.paste(a_resized, (0, 0), a_resized)
combined.paste(b_resized, (0, a_resized.size[1] + gap), b_resized)

# Save PNG (high quality)
combined.save(f'{base}/fig1_combined.png', dpi=(300, 300))

# Save PDF (high quality)
combined.save(f'{base}/fig1_combined.pdf', dpi=(300, 300), resolution=300)

print(f'Combined: {combined.size}')
print(f'Panel A resized: {a_resized.size}')
print(f'Panel B resized: {b_resized.size}')
print('Done')
